reason: The plugin is primarily a user-interface layout enhancement for DeepSeek Harness web UI, adding a General Settings toggle that expands chat and related session page elements from a fixed-width column to full available width. Evidence in the README and package manifest indicates it works by injecting client-side style/settings logic in the web profile and persisting a local preference, with no functional server-side logic or external integration described.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 网页端插件，在通用设置中提供“宽屏模式”开关，可将会话详情页内容列从固定 748px 调整为占满可用宽度。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin that adds a General Settings toggle to make the session detail page use full browser width instead of a fixed 748px content column.

capabilities: Persists plugin preference in DSH settings
Injects client-side CSS/DOM behavior for width control

reasons.code: README states this is a DSH web UI plugin that adds a Widescreen switch in Settings → General.
README describes switching `--dsh-chat-content-width` to `100%` via an `html[data-dsh-widescreen="on"]`-scoped stylesheet rule and setting an HTML attribute.
Package manifest includes a web client plugin with immediate injection and registers `lib/index.js` and client artifacts, confirming runtime behavior is loaded into the browser session.

capabilities: Persists plugin preference in DSH settings
Injects client-side CSS/DOM behavior for width control
